stages.observe_blocks: Inspect all three RGB views to locate the three blocks visually and select a visible base block and an unstacked block.
stages.select_arm: Select the arm with a visibly clear approach to the chosen unstacked block using RGB views and measured EEF and joint states.
stages.approach: Move the selected arm toward the visible grasp region while checking clearance after each discrete motion.
stages.align: Adjust EEF position and single-axis orientation until the open gripper visibly brackets the chosen block.
stages.grasp: Close the gripper around the block and inspect the RGB views for visible capture before attempting a lift.
stages.lift: Lift incrementally and check that the block visibly rises with the gripper and clears its support.
stages.move_to_stack: Move the held block above the visible base block or existing stack while monitoring grip retention and clearance.
stages.place: Lower the held block incrementally until the RGB views provide evidence of alignment and contact with the supporting block.
stages.release: Open the gripper and inspect whether the placed block remains visibly supported.
stages.retreat: Withdraw the open gripper incrementally along a visibly clear path while monitoring the stack for movement.
stages.verify: Inspect all three views for three visibly stacked and stable blocks, returning to observe_blocks if another placement or visual retry is needed.

notes: Each low-level decision uses OpenAI Decisions API gpt-6-luna and directly inspects the current three RGB views plus measured EEF and joint states.
Use only discrete XYZ direction commands with lengths of 5, 15, 30, or 45 mm, single-axis rotation increments of 0.18 rad, and available gripper commands.
Reobserve after every command; use smaller translation increments near blocks, support surfaces, and possible collisions.
Do not use object ground truth, privileged layout information, reward signals, or invisible object coordinates.
If visibility or alignment is insufficient, stop advancing, return to observe_blocks or align, and retry from fresh visual evidence.
If capture, lift, placement, or release fails visibly, reassess the current scene and repeat the necessary stages without assuming the previous action worked.
Repeat select_arm through verify for each remaining unstacked block, selecting targets from current RGB evidence.
Verification describes observable evidence only; ambiguous, occluded, or unstable arrangements remain unverified, and this specification makes no success claim.
